add.invariant: new applicable live rows require original expiry, immutable while live; exact retry binds expiry and proof only on live receipt; on expiry scrub client expiry to NULL; legacy null is unknown and no backfill
add.state_and_scrub: login terminal clears owner/lease; direct and recovery tombstones scrub client expiry, sensitive results, proof, owner and lease. Retain flow ID, kind, operation ID, startingEpoch, purge horizon and, for recovery, source FK reference until physical purge.
add.proof_and_aad: original_flow_cookie_hmac binds original REFRESH/LOGOUT flow proof. When REFRESH or LOGOUT issues result flow proof, exact result flow cookie ciphertext is required; successful LOGOUT always issues an active flow cookie, increments generation and requires ciphertext. v2 direct-operation-flow-cookie AAD binds table, REFRESH or LOGOUT kind and immutable row tuple; cross-column/row swaps fail.
add.server_cutoff: At first receipt: source min(client expiry, DB receipt time+900s, source receipt expiry); recovery min(recovery client expiry, DB receipt time+900s, source server cutoff, source and recovery receipt expiry). DB checks before every mutation; immutable while live and scrubbed at expiry.
add.source_fk: Actual migration has no source FK. Add recovery fixed REFRESH kind CHECK and composite RESTRICT FK (flow_id, source_operation_kind, source_refresh_operation_id) to direct receipt primary key; purge recovery before source.
add.recovery_generation_invariant: All three generation values are required by application for live recovery; null fails closed. Scrub all three to NULL on tombstone; DB CHECK is not claimed to enforce the live requirement.

overrides.preserve: existing credentials, exact origins, preflight and CSRF semantics

limitations: server receipt TTL is based on DB receipt time and does not prove client elapsed time

Server DB-time cutoff bounds accepted retries after receipt and supports reload with valid binding proof and live original identity, but cannot establish client elapsed time before receipt or prior clock accuracy.
legacy missing expiry cannot be reconstructed; GET-only or reauthentication
scope_boundary: New expiry headers and fields apply only to REFRESH and refresh recovery. Preserve all other operation TTL, proof, CSRF, Origin, replay and security rules.
recovery_admission: NONE/NOT_RECEIVED without confirmed receipt and cutoff: zero retry POST regardless of retained tuple; GET-only/reauth. NONE alone does not prove no previous attempt. A first POST for an explicit new recovery is permitted only within the living execution when ID and original cutoff were stored and read back and memory directly proves that this operation has not crossed its dispatch boundary, with verified live canonical source and both deadlines. Reload, conflict or uncertainty is GET-only/reauth; server fencing handles concurrent tabs.
